subject: Trial reprieve request — PO queued in finance
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@vesta.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@vesta.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request for trial reprieve — PO caught in finance

Markus / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited and we started a sandbox trial on Friday. Finance has the PO in their queue but they flagged a vendor verification step which is delaying sign-off. Procurement estimates a 10–12 day delay before the PO is fully approved.

We have active work that would benefit from keeping the sandbox live (integration tests + a short POC). Can Redwood provide a short, temporary extension or some usage credits so we don’t lose momentum while procurement finishes? I attached the draft PO and the SOW for reference.

Appreciate any help.

—Tom
Tom Alvarez
Director of Engineering
Vesta Therapeutics
Attachment: PO_draft_8921.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@vesta.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request for trial reprieve — PO caught in finance

Hi Tom — thanks for the quick context and for sharing the draft PO. Totally understand the risk of losing momentum.

Proposal from our side: we can provisionally extend the trial for 7 days and apply a one-time 10k token credit to the account while procurement clears. If you need more runway, we can re-evaluate after the PO update on Jan 22. To move forward, could you confirm the primary project owner and the expected go-live gate that needs to remain testable? Also, please confirm that the PO draft you sent is the latest — Monica, Ben, looping you in to confirm the numbers and sign-off flow.

I’ll hold off on a formal credit until Monica confirms feasibility from the CS side and Ben confirms commercial ok.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | markus.klein@redwood.com

Markus / Monica — forwarding Vesta’s note. Quick summary of ask: 7–10 day trial extension + small usage credit while procurement clears. Proposed credit economics: 10k tokens (non-refundable) or enable a time-bound sandbox with feature parity. Finance will need a one-line approval to provision credits outside normal billing. Monica: can CS implement the temporary sandbox toggle and monitor for abuse? Markus: can you confirm commercial ok for 10k and we’ll record as an authorization on the deal?

Tom / Procurement team — thanks for the update and for attaching the SOW. I’ve approved a provisional 10-day extension plus a one-time 10k token credit to keep your sandbox live. This is a temporary goodwill credit tied to DEAL-8921 and will be applied immediately; normal billing resumes once the PO is approved. If procurement needs a short addendum confirming the terms, Ben will share our standard trial-addendum doc.

Please note the credit is contingent on the PO clearing by Jan 29; if we haven’t received a PO by then we’ll re-open the discussion but won’t retroactively invoice for use during the extended window. Monica: CS will load the sandbox and monitor usage; Ben: please upload the addendum to the deal record and confirm once the credit is applied.

Thanks — happy to help keep the POC momentum going.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
